newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble firm as T-bill sales near.
newsitem.headline: Rouble firm as T-bill sales near.

text.p: The rouble was stable on Monday as banks sought funds ahead of Wednesday's sales of government securities, dealers said.
On Wednesday February 26 the central bank is auctioning 7.5 trillion roubles of one-year paper and 4.5 trillion roubles of three-month bills.
roubles/dollar Feb 24 midday Feb 24 early Feb 21 close
"People are looking at the auctions and anticipate rouble demand ahead of them. So dollar selling is prevailing," Aljba Alliance Bank chief dealer Dmitry Slobodnik said.
Another dealer said the rouble could ease later today or on Tuesday, given currently inactive investments in T-bills.
